name: ProjectRoom
title: Private Client Delivery & Approval Portal
problem: When project updates, delivery notes and approvals live in separate messages, clients lose context and teams struggle to establish the next agreed step.
solution: A private WordPress workspace puts milestones, protected delivery briefs, client approvals, change requests and actor-attributed activity in one place, with access checked against the assigned project member.
features: Native WordPress login and client membership checks
Private delivery brief downloads behind access checks
Change request, revision and approval state workflow
Staff project creation and actor-attributed history
verification: 24 live WordPress integration checks passed across administrator and two client accounts, covering cross-project read/download/write denial, CSRF protection and the complete review/revision/approval workflow.
limitations: Locally verified independent project with fictional sample clients and project content. One assigned client per project; administrator staff. No file upload, email, invoicing or public hosting. Delivery briefs are private text downloads.
flow: Staff creates milestone → Delivers brief → Client requests changes → Staff revises → Client approves
captions: Actual authenticated client overview showing milestone progress, review status, the project contact and activity history.
Actual saved client decision with updated milestone status and activity history.
